title: Create: Better Train Whistles
description: Replace the default train whistle with iconic steam train whistles like the Polar Express and Big Boy
body:
**Create: Better Train Whistles** replaces the default train whistle sounds of the popular Create mod, with sounds from iconic steam engines. This pack replaces both the standard whistle along with the deep whistle sounds for all the main train interactions including: both manual whistles, and automated station aproach whistles.

This pack includes sounds from 2 popular steam engines:

 🚂 - **Sierra Railway No. 3** (aka the Polar Express whistle)

 🚂 - **Union Pacific Big Boy**



_This pack is ideal for anyone looking for a more realistic and immersive railway experience.
_


⚠️ **How to Load Pack:**

It is highly recomended under heavily modded environments that the resource pack is loaded and unloaded from the main menu. Any attempt to switch the pack on/off in-game may result in timeouts or crashes.

This pack is designed for use with [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
